## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, owners and invariant.

## Validation

- Commands, scope and actual results:
- Unverified checks and blockers:
- Fixture/native/provider/cloud evidence scope and cleanup:

## Documentation and review

- [ ] Affected guidance/examples/skills/diagrams reconciled, or source-backed no-change reason recorded.
- [ ] Required harness/docs checks passed; visual review recorded for changed diagrams.
- [ ] Independent Sol and Opus reviews plus affected security/concurrency review completed.
- [ ] Known P0/P1/P2 findings resolved; fixes reviewed and invalidated checks rerun.

Mandatory live proof gaps keep release readiness blocked even with passing CI.
